service.description: Create a Sales account of an organization of the caller's sales scope: an organization (organizationName) or, with partyTypeEnumId PtyPerson, an individual customer (firstName, lastName), owned by that organization (Party.ownerPartyId; organizationPartyId, else the caller's active or only organization), with the Account role and Customer (default) or Prospect, an optional parent account (an account of the scope, of the same organization or shared), an account manager (managerPartyId, a person who works for the organization; else the caller when they do), and an optional email address and phone number. Refuses a caller without SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED), an organization outside the scope or none chosen (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a parent it may not see or of another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a manager who does not work for the organization (MANAGER_INVALID) and a missing name (NAME_REQUIRED).

Make a person the account's manager from now: the current manager's relationship (PrtAccountManager) ended, the new one started. A sales manager or administrator (SALES_TEAM_MANAGE or SALES_CONFIGURE) changes the manager of any account of their organization; a representative may only take an account with no manager. Refuses a caller without SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT, an account outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a shared account (ACCOUNT_SHARED) and a person who does not work for the account's organization (MANAGER_INVALID). Names the revision read (P4, F99): get#CustomerSales' managerRevision, the current manager relationship's ("0" with none); a stale one is refused (REVISION_CHANGED).

Create a person as a contact of an account of the caller's sales scope: a PrtContact relationship from the person to the account from now, the person owned by the account's organization (for a shared account, organizationPartyId or the caller's active or only organization) with the Contact role, and an optional title (relationshipName), email address and phone number. Refuses a caller without SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT, an account outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a missing name (NAME_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: relationshipName
parameter.description: The contact's title at the account

service.description: Make an existing person a contact of an account of the caller's sales scope from now (PrtContact, the Contact role); a person already a current contact of it answers that relationship. The person must be one the caller may see (of the scope or shared, never someone else's personal contact or an internal party). Refuses a caller without SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT and an account or person it may not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Does not delete: ends a contact's relationship (PrtContact) with an account of the caller's sales scope from now; the person is kept, with their other accounts. Refuses a caller without SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT and a relationship of another kind or of an account outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Names the relationship's revision read (P4, F99: find#AccountContacts' and get#CustomerSales' revision); a stale one is refused (REVISION_CHANGED).
